definitions.explanation: An artificial device that replaces a missing leg or part of a leg. Used in medical and daily life contexts.

examples.japanese: {義足|ぎそく}で{歩|ある}く{練習|れんしゅう}をする。
examples.english: Practice walking with a prosthetic leg.

examples.japanese: {義足|ぎそく}のランナーがマラソンを{完走|かんそう}した。
examples.english: A runner with a prosthetic leg completed the marathon.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{進歩|しんぽ}により、{義足|ぎそく}は{軽|かる}くなり、{自然|しぜん}な{動|うご}きができるようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to technological advances, prosthetic legs have become lighter and allow more natural movement.

notes:
KANJI NOTE:
{義|ぎ} here means "artificial" or "substitute" (as in {義理|ぎり}), and {足|そく} means "leg/foot." The same {義|ぎ} prefix appears in {義手|ぎしゅ} (prosthetic arm) and {義歯|ぎし} (false tooth/denture).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義足|ぎそく}をつける (put on a prosthetic leg)
- {義足|ぎそく}で{歩|ある}く (walk with a prosthetic leg)
- {義足|ぎそく}を{装着|そうちゃく}する (wear/attach a prosthetic leg)

RELATED WORDS:
- {義手|ぎしゅ}: prosthetic arm/hand
- {義歯|ぎし}: false tooth, denture
- {義眼|ぎがん}: prosthetic eye
